import pytest
from datetime import date
from late_fee import LateFeeCalculator

DUE = date(2026, 1, 5)  # Monday

def calc(today): return LateFeeCalculator(today=today)

@pytest.mark.parametrize("bal", [0, -100])
def test_nonpositive_balance(bal):
    assert calc(date(2027, 1, 1)).compute_fee_cents(bal, DUE) == 0

def test_before_due_date():
    assert calc(date(2026, 1, 1)).compute_fee_cents(100000, DUE) == 0

def test_today_equals_due():
    assert calc(DUE).compute_fee_cents(100000, DUE) == 0

def test_exactly_grace_period():  # 10 weekdays
    assert calc(date(2026, 1, 19)).compute_fee_cents(100000, DUE) == 0

def test_min_fee_applied():  # 11 weekdays, 1 billable
    assert calc(date(2026, 1, 20)).compute_fee_cents(10000, DUE) == 500

def test_normal_proration():  # 30 weekdays, 20 billable
    assert calc(date(2026, 2, 16)).compute_fee_cents(1000000, DUE) == 10000

def test_round_half_up(monkeypatch):
    c = calc(date(2026, 1, 20))
    assert c.compute_fee_cents(2001000, DUE) == 1001

def test_max_cap(monkeypatch):
    c = calc(date(2026, 1, 20))
    monkeypatch.setattr(c, "_weekday_days_between", lambda s, e: 610)
    assert c.compute_fee_cents(100000, DUE) == 25000

def test_weekends_excluded():
    c = calc(date(2026, 1, 12))  # Mon->Mon = 7 cal days
    assert c._weekday_days_between(DUE, date(2026, 1, 12)) == 5

def test_end_before_start():
    assert calc(DUE)._weekday_days_between(date(2026, 2, 1), DUE) == 0

def test_default_today(monkeypatch):
    assert LateFeeCalculator()._today == date.today()
